headline: GM updates its trucks’ native software to coexist with CarPlay
summary: GM updates truck software for easier control access. New picture-in-picture displays added for CarPlay/Android Auto. This marks a shift from GM's past anti-phone mirroring stance.

headline: Microsoft issues emergency Windows 11 update to fix its record-breaking patch
summary: Microsoft released an emergency Windows 11 update. It fixes issues from its September patch, which was the largest ever. The original patch affected folder shares and other systems.

headline: Volvo’s plug-in hybrid XC60 and XC90 can really go the distance
summary: Volvo's updated XC60 and XC90 PHEVs boast extended electric range. Most PHEVs offer 30-50 miles, but Volvo aims to push limits. This release comes as hybrid sales dominate the market.

headline: Valve is still figuring out ‘how and when’ to do Steam Deck 2
summary: Valve is contemplating a next-gen Steam Deck 2. The company recently launched its 2026 hardware lineup. Development details on Steam Deck 2 are currently unconfirmed.

headline: Wolverine Developer Insomniac Promises to 'Further Refine the Player Experience' Based on Feedback
summary: Insomniac will refine Marvel's Wolverine based on player feedback. The developer expressed pride in the game. Improvements aim to enhance the overall player experience.

headline: The Creep Tapes Season 3 Review
summary: The Creep Tapes Season 3 received a positive review. It's described as mean, hilarious, and utterly horrifying. This season delivers a strong horror experience.

headline: Wardogs Sells 2 Million Copies in 5 Days as Early Access Shooter Blows Up on Steam
summary: Early Access shooter Wardogs sold 2 million copies in five days. The game quickly gained popularity on Steam. Its rapid sales mark incredible success.

headline: Buffy the Vampire Slayer Reboot Cancellation Means Fans Will Never Discover if Buffy and Angel Ended Up Together, Sarah Michelle Gellar Jokes
summary: Hulu canceled the Buffy the Vampire Slayer reboot. Sarah Michelle Gellar joked fans won't know Buffy and Angel's fate. The cancellation was a shock to many.

headline: Key findings from Lucy Letby Thirlwall Inquiry
summary: The Thirlwall Inquiry revealed "complete failure" to protect babies. This occurred at the neonatal unit where Lucy Letby worked. The findings highlight serious systemic issues.

headline: State pension likely to top £13,000 a year as UK wage growth slows to 3.9%
summary: UK state pension is projected to exceed £13,000 annually. This comes amid a slowdown in UK wage growth to 3.9%. The increase sparks debate on long-term affordability and fairness.

headline: Denmark says Russian warship fired flares at military helicopter
summary: Denmark accused a Russian warship of firing flares at its military helicopter. The Danish PM called Russia's behavior "reckless." The Kremlin has not yet commented on the incident.

headline: Five things you may not know about Emmy history-maker Matthew Rhys
summary: Welsh actor Matthew Rhys made Emmy history. He became the first to win two lead acting prizes in one night. The article reveals five lesser-known facts about him.
